scripts.dev: yarn build:contracts && concurrently -n contracts,api,worker,web "yarn workspace @angia/contracts dev" "yarn workspace @angia/api dev" "yarn workspace @angia/worker dev" "yarn workspace @angia/web dev"
scripts.build: yarn workspaces foreach -At --exclude angia run build
scripts.typecheck: yarn build:contracts && yarn workspaces foreach -A --exclude angia run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.tooling.json
scripts.generate:api: yarn build:contracts && yarn workspace @angia/api generate:openapi && yarn workspace @angia/web generate:api
scripts.check:api: yarn generate:api && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/openapi.json apps/web/src/shared/api/
scripts.verify: yarn generate:api && yarn typecheck && yarn lint && yarn format:check && yarn test && yarn dup && yarn knip && yarn build
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml --project-directory . up -d --wait && yarn dev:storage-init
